title: Statistics And Research Method
modules: Selection And Formulation Of A Research
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those variables whose values can be determined by counting."
The discrete variables are those variables whose values can be determined by counting.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is termed as a sample survey."
The method is termed as a sample survey.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a circular diagram in which each class or attribute is represented by a sector whose area is proportional to the percentage or relative frequency of the class or attribute."
Pie chart is a circular diagram in which each class or attribute is represented by a sector whose area is proportional to the percentage or relative frequency of the class or attribute.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an integral part of the analysis of the data."
Interpretation is an integral part of the analysis of the data.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a conjectural statement of the relation between two or more variables."
A hypothesis is a conjectural statement of the relation between two or more variables.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the average of the two middle scores."
The midpoint is the average of the two middle scores.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a form of social research, which aims at better insight into the problem by learning from the experience gained in an attempt to solve the problems."
Action research is a form of social research, which aims at better insight into the problem by learning from the experience gained in an attempt to solve the problems.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is described as skewed if the cases tend to pile up at one end of a curve and with a long tail at the other."
Distribution shapes A distribution is described as skewed if the cases tend to pile up at one end of a curve and with a long tail at the other.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a guide showing different activities and the time allotted to each."
The work plan is a guide showing different activities and the time allotted to each.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the sample statistics to predict the band within which almost all (typically 95 percent or 99 percent) of the values will lie."
Interval estimates of parameters are the sample statistics to predict the band within which almost all (typically 95 percent or 99 percent) of the values will lie.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a construct invented by man to account for presumably motivated behaviour."
Motivation is a construct invented by man to account for presumably motivated behaviour.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to those variables which are composed of categories that can be ordered in magnitude."
The quantitative variable refers to those variables which are composed of categories that can be ordered in magnitude.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a continuous assessment component of your course."
The TMA is a continuous assessment component of your course.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ may be defined as a selected number from a population to represent it."
Sample A sample may be defined as a selected number from a population to represent it.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the difference between the lower class limit of any interval and the lower class limit of the next class interval."
Class width is the difference between the lower class limit of any interval and the lower class limit of the next class interval.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means "from what is done afterwards"."
Ex-post facto means "from what is done afterwards".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the midpoint of a distribution."
The median is the midpoint of a distribution.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with data collection, organisation, analyses and interpretation of data collected for decision making."
Statistics is concerned with data collection, organisation, analyses and interpretation of data collected for decision making.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a graphical display of a frequency distribution."
A histogram is a graphical display of a frequency distribution.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ may be defined as the science of developing the capability of the people for sustainable improvement in their quality of life."
Extension may be defined as the science of developing the capability of the people for sustainable improvement in their quality of life.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a means of testing the null hypothesis."
The standard error is a means of testing the null hypothesis.
